name: sickle_cell_disease
remarks: Simplified sickle cell disease (SCD) natural history for Synthea.
This is a starter module intended for refinement.
It oversamples SCD to ensure enough cases in small populations.
Updated to add race-based incidence logic and chronic complications (stroke, nephropathy).

Black patients are modeled with a higher baseline risk than non-Black patients.
